hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom-curve hook that enables 1:1 swaps between ETH and phiEth (an ETH-backed wrapper token). beforeSwap intercepts every swap, takes the full input from PoolManager, converts it via phiEth deposit/withdraw, and settles the output — bypassing concentrated liquidity entirely via beforeSwapReturnsDelta. Liquidity additions to the pool are permanently blocked.
